query_text: Where can I get tickets for the next NBA game?

annotations.title: How to watch San Antonio Spurs vs New York Knicks: FREE NBA Finals 2026 live streams, TV schedule, Game 2

content.text:
The **next NBA game appears to be NBA Finals Game 3: San Antonio Spurs at New York Knicks**, on **Monday, June 8, 2026 at 8:30 p.m. ET** at **Madison Square Garden**. ([tomsguide.com](https://www.tomsguide.com/entertainment/sports/watch-san-antonio-spurs-vs-new-york-knicks-free-nba-finals-2026-live-streams?utm_source=openai))

You can get tickets from:

- **Ticketmaster** — safest bet for official/verified tickets, especially via the Knicks/MSG listing.
- **SeatGeek**, **StubHub**, **Vivid Seats**, or **TickPick** — resale marketplaces; compare total prices after fees.
- **NBA.com / Knicks official site** — often routes you to the official ticketing partner.

Because it’s an NBA Finals game at MSG, prices may be very high and inventory can change fast. Make sure the listing specifically says **Game 3 — Spurs at Knicks — June 8, 2026** before buying.
